title: Look up a customer, maybe
hints: `find_customer` loops and `return`s the first match. If the loop finishes without finding one, `return None`. Normalise both emails the same way before you compare them.
In `greeting_name`, call `find_customer` and check `if customer is None:` first. After that branch, mypy knows `customer` is a `Customer`.
`customer = find_customer(customers, email)`, `if customer is None: return "Guest"`, then `return customer.nickname or customer.name`.
